stage_name: Phase 7.14 next-action navigation / blank modal hotfix

pilot_record.reported_symptom: The Overview next-action CTA 'Go to Analysis & Decisions' did not navigate; an unusable confirmation dialog appeared with title 'Confirm action', an empty body, Cancel, an enabled 'Confirm & run', no confirmation phrase and no action details.

root_cause.layer: CSS cascade origin precedence in styles.css
root_cause.declaration: #modal-backdrop { ... display: flex; ... z-index: 80; position: fixed; inset: 0 }
root_cause.mechanism: app.js hides the confirmation dialog only by setting element.hidden = true, which relies on the user-agent rule [hidden] { display: none }. A plain author display declaration outranks any user-agent declaration regardless of specificity, so #modal-backdrop kept display:flex while hidden was true. The empty dialog was painted from first paint, covered the viewport at z-index 80, intercepted every pointer event, and its own click handler (app.js:1406 baseline) called preventDefault() on the owner's CTA click.
root_cause.second_instance_same_cause: .btn { display: inline-flex } overrode hidden on the dialog buttons, so exec.hidden = true in openModalBlocked() and finishExecute() had no visual effect: Confirm stayed visible (though still disabled) on a blocked preparation and after a consumed token.
root_cause.cache_ruled_out_by: served app.js / index.html / styles.css SHA-256 identical to local bytes in every run, in both browsers, with Network.setCacheDisabled, after a cache-bypassing reload, and after a full launcher Stop + restart; Cache-Control: no-cache on the served assets

browser_level.method: styles.css and index.html reverted in place to the accepted baseline blobs, the real console restarted so it served those bytes, both harnesses run in real Edge, then both files restored and verified byte-identical to the hotfix version
browser_level.significance: The accepted Phase 7.14 browser-QA harness passes 44/44 against the accepted-baseline console that carries the defect. That is precisely why this reached a pilot: the gate asserted backdrop.hidden (always correctly true) and never the computed style, the hit-testability of a control, or the outcome of a real click. The rebuilt harness fails 13 checks against the same console.

recommendation: Independent hotfix acceptance audit before merge or pilot. Suggested focus: the [hidden] guard is the whole root-cause fix and cannot be outranked; the navigation contract is enforced behaviourally, not by string matching; the preparation validator is never stricter than UC.prepare_action; and the two accounted-for non-passing nodes are genuinely baseline-equivalent.
